method: Existing visible-playtest.mjs only, normal http://127.0.0.1:5173/, live JPEG inspection and visible UI. Read Mission Brief and How to Play before deployment. No source, test, prior review, route, fixture or hidden-state inspection; no implementation changes.

attempts.progress: Defeated the induction guard with ADS fire; recovered East Archive, Heart and West Archive; returned to the green beacon and began uplink; died before extraction completed.

observations.finding: Strong coherent rain-soaked industrial setting, cyan and amber palette, clear large title typography, reflective ground and an attractive central relay landmark.
Briefing explains receiver placement, holding E, escalation and extraction cover; handbook clearly lists ADS, reload, sprint and Soul Shift. The visor explanation is dense for a first read.

Opening guard is immediately tangible and firing while backing away defeated it. I walked into very close contact first, where the enemy filled almost the whole view. ADS, reload, shield changes and ammo rewards were visible. I did not establish successful charge breaks or critical eliminations.

Three receiver recoveries and the return-to-extraction transition worked in this attempt. Supplies made collecting cores forgiving; rushing past remaining threats left a dangerous return. West structure blocked my first direct approach, and service signs helped find entry.

Move-closer and floor-ring prompts helped correct receiver positioning. A 2.9 m approach was outside recovery range; a small strafe allowed recovery. Extraction edge distance and near-edge warnings also gave useful feedback.

Multiple recent-fire and charge labels crowded the lower center and weapon area. Threat feedback was abundant, but it did not always make the immediate shooter location obvious to me. I became caught against west service geometry during the return and lost 94 health before escaping it.
The death screen preserves recovered characters and provides a readable restored-records archive, giving the recovery objective a human payoff even after failure.

scoreRationale: A cohesive playable mission with appealing visual direction and functional recovery progression. My experience supports a promising vertical slice, with navigation friction and crowded threat communication under pressure. One short failed run does not establish sustained combat depth, balance, polish or AAA readiness.
limitations: One actual attempt, ending in death; no second attempt was started. No extraction win observed.
Chunked visible actions with Escape pauses constrain timing and aim compared with continuous human mouse play.
Software-WebGL fallback was reported; hardware renderer, FPS and audio enjoyment were not established.
No performance benchmark, settings sweep, accessibility audit or long-session stability claim.
No page errors were reported by the visible driver during the captured commands.
